verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents a self-hosted option that runs the platform in your own infrastructure so trace and operational data stay in your environment. That lets you control where data lives, but only by running it yourself. The pack has no evidence of choosing a storage region for the managed cloud. Missing for 10: managed-cloud region selection (e.g. US/EU), documented data-residency guarantees or compliance details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Self-hosted LangSmith runs the LangSmith platform in your own infrastructure so that trace and operational data stay in your environment.
Host an instance of LangSmith in your own infrastructure for observability, evaluation, and prompt engineering.
